weaknesses.what: The dark rounded toolbar at the top overlaps and floats above the white content card with its own shadow, looking like a separate control widget stacked on the surface rather than integrated into it.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar into the card's own header/chrome, or unify its color/shape language with the card below so it reads as one continuous surface.

weaknesses.what: Nothing identifies which meeting, platform, or people this is — '14:50 の会議' is a generic timestamp title and 'AI が見ている資料' names no actual resource.
weaknesses.fix: Show the real meeting/event name, source app icon, or participant names so the user can confirm the app is attached to the right meeting.

weaknesses.what: At this very first moment almost everything shown is a waiting/placeholder state (transcript, decisions, action items all empty), making the screen feel barren.
weaknesses.fix: Acceptable for a true cold-start, but consider surfacing any known context (calendar title, invited resource) earlier so the screen isn't almost entirely placeholders.

weaknesses.what: The dark pill toolbar at top overlaps and floats above the card boundary instead of being visually merged into it
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar inside the card's top edge (shared background/border) instead of letting it float above and overlap the corner radius

weaknesses.what: No indication of which real meeting/app/participants this is beyond a generic time-based title
weaknesses.fix: Surface the source (calendar event name, app being captured, or participant names) near the title

weaknesses.what: Large empty transcript and summary areas with only placeholder waiting-text make the first screen feel sparse/barren
weaknesses.fix: Use a lighter-weight empty state (e.g. single subtle hint) so the empty regions don't dominate the layout

weaknesses.what: Floating toolbar buttons are not labeled. Icons alone don't communicate their function to a first-time user.
weaknesses.fix: Add a tooltip on hover, or use icon + label for at least the most important controls (pause/play, maximize, recording stop).

weaknesses.what: 'AIが見ている資料' (Materials AI is viewing) at the bottom is cut off or unclear. What materials? Where do they come from?
weaknesses.fix: Either show a preview/list of the materials, or clarify in a tooltip what this section displays.

weaknesses.what: Right panel shows 'No speech yet' which is expected, but it reads as empty/inactive to a newcomer. Might feel like the app is not working.
weaknesses.fix: Add a light hint or placeholder message like 'Awaiting transcription...' or 'Start speaking to see transcription here' to signal the app is ready and working.

weaknesses.what: The only identifier for the meeting is a generic auto-generated timestamp title ('23:32 の会議'); there is no participant, source app, or calendar-event context anywhere on screen.
weaknesses.fix: Show the actual meeting/event title or participant names when available, or at least the audio source (app/mic) being captured.

weaknesses.what: The small capsule toolbar at the top overlaps and sits proud of the main card's top edge, visually detaching it as a floating overlay rather than part of the same surface.
weaknesses.fix: Recess the toolbar into the card's own header or give it a shared shadow/edge treatment so it reads as one continuous surface.

weaknesses.what: Four separate empty-state messages (transcript, decisions, to-dos, and implicitly the resource link) compete at similar visual weight with no single focal point while waiting for speech.
weaknesses.fix: Collapse or de-emphasize the empty sections and give the single 'listening' state more visual priority until real content arrives.

weaknesses.what: The top pill toolbar (pause/comment/expand/more/stop) overlaps and floats above the main panel with its own shadow, visually detaching it from the rest of the interface like a separate floating control strip.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar flush into the main panel's top edge, or remove the shadow/gap so it reads as one continuous frame.

weaknesses.what: No meeting title, calendar source, or participant info is shown — only a generic time-based label — so a first-time viewer cannot tell what meeting or source this is.
weaknesses.fix: Pull in the real meeting/event title or participant names when available, or clearly label it as an ad-hoc/untitled recording.

weaknesses.what: Three separate placeholder 'waiting for...' messages (listening, decisions, todos) make the screen feel empty and repetitive before anything has happened.
weaknesses.fix: Collapse the empty states into a single lighter-weight waiting indicator until real content starts flowing in.

weaknesses.what: The black floating control bar at top feels detached from the main interface—reads like a separate floating widget rather than integrated toolbar
weaknesses.fix: Anchor the control bar as part of the window chrome or window header, or visually integrate it with the main content area

weaknesses.what: Right panel (Transcription/Translation/Subtitles tabs) is mostly empty, creating visual dead space and unclear purpose on first viewing
weaknesses.fix: Either show placeholder content explaining what will appear here, or collapse/hide the panel until transcription begins

weaknesses.what: Bottom element 'AIが見ている資料' (Materials AI is watching) is vague and unexplained—materials from where? What purpose does this serve?
weaknesses.fix: Clarify this section's purpose with a label or remove it if not essential to core function

weaknesses.what: Multiple waiting/placeholder messages on left panel ('待っています' appearing twice) plus 'まだ発話がありません' on right create redundancy
weaknesses.fix: Consolidate into a single clear initial state message, or show actual content placeholders

weaknesses.what: Four action buttons at bottom-right (Real-time summary / Cost / Decisions / Actions) lack visual priority or explanation
weaknesses.fix: Add brief labels or tooltips; differentiate primary actions from secondary; consider grouping or reordering

weaknesses.what: The top pill toolbar (pause/comment/expand/more/stop) has a different corner radius and floats above/overlapping the main card's top edge instead of sharing its border, so it reads as a separate floating control bar rather than part of one surface.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar into the main panel's own header with a matching radius and continuous background/shadow so it reads as one shape.

weaknesses.what: The only identifying label is the generic timestamp title '23:34 の会議' — no participant names, meeting title, or source app/calendar icon is shown, so it's unclear which real meeting or call this is.
weaknesses.fix: Surface the actual meeting title or participant names (e.g. from a calendar or call-app integration) instead of a bare time-based placeholder.

weaknesses.what: Four separate 'waiting for...' placeholder strings (聞いています..., まだ発話がありません, 決まったことを待っています, やることを待っています) are all shown at once, which is repetitive and makes the screen feel sparse/premature this early in the recording.
weaknesses.fix: Consolidate into a single unified waiting state until real content starts arriving, rather than one waiting message per section.

weaknesses.what: The top pill toolbar overlaps the card's top edge instead of being docked inside it, reading as a separate floating overlay window.
weaknesses.fix: Embed the toolbar as the card's own header bar (flush with the card's top edge and border) instead of a floating pill that straddles the boundary.

weaknesses.what: 'AI が見ている資料' sits outside the main card, below the input bar, on the bare background — visually orphaned from the rest of the surface.
weaknesses.fix: Move it inside the card, e.g. as a small footer row beneath the chat input, so it reads as part of the same panel.

weaknesses.what: Nothing identifies the meeting source (which app/call, which participants) — only a generic timestamp title and a generic 'listening' state.
weaknesses.fix: Show the source app icon/name or a real meeting title near '23:34の会議' so the user knows what it's actually capturing.

weaknesses.what: The floating control bar at top and resource indicator at bottom create visual breaks in the unified surface feeling.
weaknesses.fix: Integrate controls more visually into the main panel layout, or remove the bottom resource indicator if not immediately actionable.

weaknesses.what: The purpose of left panel (transcript) versus right panel (processing UI) is not immediately clear—they seem to show related but different information.
weaknesses.fix: Add subtle labels or visual cues explaining that left shows meeting history and right shows AI processing/summaries.

weaknesses.what: The right panel showing 'no speech yet' contradicts the visible transcript on the left, creating cognitive friction.
weaknesses.fix: Either unify the transcription display or clarify that they represent different capture states (real-time vs. historical).

weaknesses.what: The bottom 'AIが読んでいる資料' section is vague and its relationship to the meeting recording is unclear.
weaknesses.fix: Either integrate this into the main flow with clearer purpose, or remove if not critical to current task.

weaknesses.what: The black pill control bar at the top overlaps the main card's edge and reads as a separate floating overlay rather than part of the same surface.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the controls into the main card's header bar (or give them a connecting visual seam) so it reads as one piece, not a widget stacked on top.

weaknesses.what: The meeting title is just an auto-generated timestamp ('23:33 の会議') with no participant names, source app, or calendar link visible.
weaknesses.fix: Surface the actual meeting title/participants or the app/call source being captured so the user can confirm what is being recorded.

weaknesses.what: The top black pill toolbar overlaps and floats above the main card's edge instead of being docked inside it, reading as a separate overlay window stacked on the app rather than part of it.
weaknesses.fix: Embed the toolbar as a header row inside the card's own rounded boundary so the whole surface reads as one shape.

weaknesses.what: The only identifier for the meeting is a bare timestamp title ('23:33 の会議'); no participants, calendar name, or connected source is visible, so a first-time viewer can't tell what is actually being recorded.
weaknesses.fix: Surface the meeting/event name or participant names if known, and show a preview of the linked material under 'AI が見ている資料' instead of leaving it unexplained.

weaknesses.what: The four action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are grayed out with no visible reason or hint for when they become active.
weaknesses.fix: Add a short disabled-state hint (e.g. 'available once there is a transcript') or tooltip.

weaknesses.what: Floating control bar at top has distinct visual treatment (rounded, shadowed) that creates subtle visual break from the main window body.
weaknesses.fix: Integrate the control bar visually with the main frame, or make the separation intentional and thematic rather than accidental.

weaknesses.what: Right panel (transcription/translation/subtitles) is mostly empty during startup, creating visual imbalance and suggesting the section is secondary rather than equal to the meeting notes on the left.
weaknesses.fix: Populate the placeholder state with actionable guidance ('Transcriptions will appear here as speech is detected') or redistribute space so the layout feels intentional even when empty.

weaknesses.what: Bottom link 'AIが読んでいる資料' (Material AI is reading) lacks context—no indication of what material, where it came from, or why it's relevant to this meeting.
weaknesses.fix: Either show the material inline, add a brief description of what the AI is processing, or remove it from the start screen if not yet functional.
